script: Saturn's small moon Enceladus shoots water into space. Giant geysers spray icy jets from cracks near its south pole. Some of that ice ends up in one of Saturn's rings. The water comes from a hidden ocean beneath its frozen surface. That makes Enceladus one of the best places to look for life beyond Earth.
